reason: I work full time, so it's Saturdays only, and I already do free library storytime on Tuesdays. I'd grab the free first visit, but I wouldn't commit money before seeing it, and I'll be chasing my kid anyway so the coffee isn't much of a draw.
objection: I only get weekends, so a membership would get maybe 3-4 visits a month at best, and I'd still be up chasing my toddler instead of sitting with a coffee. Free library storytime and the park cover most of what we need.
would_change_my_mind: A great free first visit on a Saturday where my kid actually wants to go back, plus a drop-in or pack price that works for weekend-only use.
